subject: Paid Memberships Pro 2.9.7 (pin 1a900be3f09f), development subject
sampling: every 5th finding in site order (indices 0,5,...,45), requested by the maintainer
standard: TP = attacker-controlled request data reaches SQL text without prepare, integer cast, or esc_sql inside quotes (sanitize_text_field does not count). TP-privileged = same, reachable only by an administrator/privileged capability. FP-guarded = escaped/cast/allow-listed/bound first. FP-not-attacker = value from the database, a constant or internal state.

sample.reason: every interpolated value is intval/esc_sql-in-quotes/constant; witness source $type never enters SQL except as an extra apply_filters argument
REST POST /pmpro/v1/discount_code: code = sanitize_text_field(param), interpolated in quotes in save(); needs pmpro_discountcodes capability. Witness names $this->expires, not $this->code
orderby via allow-list map sanitize_orderby, order via ==, search_key in_array allow-list, $s esc_sql in quotes
$this->membership_id loaded from the order's DB row; witness source $update_order->BillingFrequency is internal state (upstream hardened it with prepare in 2.9.8)
$this->user_id = $dbobj->user_id from the DB row; the injectable query is the separate id lookup at line 671
$user->ID and old level ids are internal
(int) cast code_id, WordPress user id, internal order id; witness source $morder->user_id
$user_ID = $_REQUEST['user_id'] raw, interpolated in quotes; needs the membership-level capability. Sibling finding at line 337 (raw expires_hour/minute) is also real

reading: SQL injection precision on this sample is 20% against a 95% gate. Six of eight false positives share one cause: an object field ($this->x, $obj->x) is treated as attacker input although, in these PHP classes, it is loaded from the database or set internally. The real findings are both privileged (admin capability); none in the sample is reachable unauthenticated. The declared target (class.memberorder.php:936) is a true positive outside the sample.
limits: One subject, development data; a 10-finding sample has a wide interval.
Privilege and reachability judged from capability checks in code, not by exploitation.
